illustration.description: Flat cartoon illustration in a clean, hand-drawn sticker style with thick black outlines and flat fills. A bald, faceless-looking adult man in a short-sleeved bright blue t-shirt stands in profile facing left, leaning forward with his head bowed sharply down and his neck craned. He holds a dark navy smartphone in both hands at waist height and looks down at it. Three small red zigzag stress or strain lines sit near the back of his neck and shoulder to suggest pain. Light skin tones with subtle shading, simple shapes, no background scenery, pure white background.
